Watch Together

Build a guided, annotated tour of any stretch of the battle -- your own stops, your own notes -- then share it as a file for someone else to load and watch at their own pace.

✓ Live Sync below connects two browsers directly to each other (peer-to-peer, over WebRTC) using a free public connection broker -- no account or server of ours involved. One person starts a session and shares a 5-letter code; anyone who enters it sees the same tick move on their own screen in real time. Because it depends on a third-party public broker rather than infrastructure we run, treat it as best-effort -- if it's ever down, Export tour / Import tour below is the reliable fallback for sharing a tour asynchronously.
